mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over the prior 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential housing starts (HOUST) and a decline in real sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1150 and RSAFS < 440000.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of sustained industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105.0), the S&P 500 exhibits positive 20-day returns due to strengthening corporate earnings outlook.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO > 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the year-over-year CPI inflation rate above 2.0% over the prior 3 months signals accelerating inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL y/y > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) over the prior 6 months signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS < 143000 and INDPRO < 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of low and stable interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), the S&P 500 exhibits positive 20-day returns due to accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.
